questions.q: Which of these is a form rather than a shape?
questions.why: Form is three-dimensional; a sphere has volume, the others are flat.

questions.q: Strong contrast of light and dark, as used by Rembrandt, is called
questions.why: Chiaroscuro means light-dark contrast for drama and solidity.
Frottage is a rubbing taken over a textured surface.

questions.q: Explain how you would use tone to make a drawn apple look three-dimensional.
questions.model: Find the light source; put highlight where light hits, grade through mid-tones to a core shadow, add reflected light and a cast shadow on the surface.
points: highlight and graded mid-tones to dark core shadow
